chosen_premises: An economic audit of Waystation Echo reveals sentries have turned their annual holiday Secret Santa into a multi-million-credit derivatives market, with researchers noting the station's entire sovereign wealth fund now mathematically collapses if anyone opens a novelty mug.

Labor researchers at a deep-space listening post find the garrison has adopted a vintage property-trading board game as hard currency, casually noting that the base commander has been forced to sleep in an unpressurised duct after repeatedly landing on a corporal's plastic hotel.

Sociologists surveying an abyssal border monastery report the brothers have converted their endowment into mint-condition miniature war gaming figurines, a researcher explaining the holy order is technically the sector’s richest creditor but cannot repel raiders without ruining the boxes' collector grade.

Behavioral economists at an isolated patrol garrison discover troops running a high-stakes fantasy league tracking pirate raids, the lead analyst confirming sentries deliberately left the perimeter guns unmanned to protect their defensive bracket's casualty payout.
